title: Ragefire Chasm
content: Ragefire Chasm is a level 13-18 dungeon located beneath Orgrimmar. This fiery cavern is inhabited by troggs and dark shaman cultists. Key bosses include Taragaman the Hungerer and Bazzalan. Players can find mail armor, weapons, and various items. This dungeon teaches basic group coordination and is often the first instance new players experience. It's accessible through a cave entrance in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.

title: The Deadmines
content: The Deadmines is a level 15-21 dungeon located in the hills of Westfall. This extensive mine system is controlled by the Defias Brotherhood led by Edwin VanCleef. Key bosses include Rhahk'Zor, Sneed's Shredder, and Edwin VanCleef himself. Players navigate complex mine cart tracks and fight various Defias members. This dungeon offers good loot for its level range and teaches players about pirate themes and organized crime in Azeroth.

title: Wailing Caverns
content: Wailing Caverns is a level 15-25 dungeon located in the Barrens. This vast underground cave system has been corrupted by the druid Naralex and his followers. Key bosses include Lady Anacondra, Lord Cobrahn, and Mutanus the Devourer. Players fight various serpent creatures and corrupted wildlife. This dungeon features a unique emerald dream corruption theme and offers good experience and loot for mid-level players.

title: Shadowfang Keep
content: Shadowfang Keep is a level 18-30 Vanilla dungeon in Silverpine Forest. Archmage Arugal's worgen and the keep's restless dead occupy its haunted halls. Encounters include Rethilgore, Razorclaw the Butcher, Baron Silverlaine, Commander Springvale, Odo the Blindwatcher, Fenrus the Devourer, Wolf Master Nandos, and Arugal. The winding castle rewards careful pulls and coordination.

title: Blackfathom Deeps
content: Blackfathom Deeps is a level 20-30 dungeon reached from the Zoram Strand in Ashenvale. The flooded temple is occupied by Twilight's Hammer cultists, naga, satyrs, and corrupted creatures. Key encounters include Ghamoo-ra, Lady Sarevess, Gelihast, Twilight Lord Kelris, and Aku'mai. Its long watery route rewards preparation and careful navigation.

title: Lower Blackrock Spire
content: Lower Blackrock Spire is a level 55-60 dungeon located in the Burning Steppes. This lower section of Blackrock Spire is controlled by various dark creatures and warlords. Key bosses include Highlord Omokk, Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin, and War Master Voone. Players fight through orc and dragonkin enemies in a volcanic fortress. This high-level dungeon offers excellent loot and is part of the Blackrock Mountain complex.

title: Scholomance
content: Scholomance is a level 55-60 dungeon located in the Western Plaguelands. This haunted school of necromancy is controlled by the Scourge and dark mages. Key bosses include Kirtonos the Herald, Jandice Barov, and Darkmaster Gandling. Players fight through classrooms and libraries battling undead scholars and experiments. This dungeon has a strong academic horror theme with excellent loot for its level.

title: Stratholme
content: Stratholme is a level 55-60 dungeon located in the Eastern Plaguelands. This cursed city is divided into two wings: Scarlet Stratholme and Undead Stratholme. Key bosses include Balnazzar, Baron Rivendare, and various undead lords. Players navigate through a ruined city fighting Scourge and Scarlet Crusade forces. This large dungeon offers excellent loot and has a strong plague and undead theme.

title: Onyxia's Lair
content: Onyxia's Lair is a level 60 raid beneath the Dragonmurk in Dustwallow Marsh and requires the Drakefire Amulet attunement. The black dragon Onyxia fights on the ground, takes flight while whelps emerge, then lands for a final phase with fear and erupting floor cracks. The raid offers powerful loot, Onyxia's head quest rewards, and the Mature Black Dragon Sinew used in the hunter epic weapon chain.

title: Molten Core
content: Molten Core is a level 60 raid dungeon located beneath Blackrock Mountain. This fiery cavern is home to Ragnaros and his elemental lieutenants. Key bosses include Lucifron, Magmadar, Gehennas, and Ragnaros himself. Players fight through waves of fire elementals and major bosses. This raid offers legendary items and is the premier endgame content of Classic WoW.

title: Blackwing Lair
content: Blackwing Lair is a level 60 raid dungeon located in Blackrock Spire. This draconic fortress is home to Nefarian and his black dragonflight. Key bosses include Razorgore, Vaelastrasz, and Nefarian himself. Players navigate through dragon-themed chambers fighting drakes and lieutenants. This raid offers excellent loot and is known for its complex encounters requiring precise coordination.

title: Naxxramas
content: Naxxramas is a level 60 Vanilla raid necropolis above the Eastern Plaguelands and requires Argent Dawn attunement. Its Arachnid, Plague, Military, and Construct wings lead toward Sapphiron and Kel'Thuzad. Encounters such as Anub'Rekhan, Maexxna, Heigan, the Four Horsemen, and Thaddius demand precise coordination and resistance preparation. It is a pinnacle Vanilla raid with Tier 3 armor and other endgame loot.

title: Emerald Sanctum
content: Emerald Sanctum is a custom level 60 Turtle WoW raid reached through Hyjal. Players must be in a raid group and carry the Gemstone of Ysera to enter. The sanctum expands Vanilla endgame progression with Emerald Dream lore, nature-themed enemies, coordinated boss mechanics, and custom rewards while remaining within the level-60 ruleset.

title: Blackrock Depths
content: Blackrock Depths is a level 52-60 dungeon located in Blackrock Mountain. This massive prison complex is home to the Dark Iron dwarves and various prisoners. Key bosses include Lord Incendius, Bael'Gar, and Emperor Dagran Thaurissan. Players navigate through forges, arenas, and cells fighting dwarves and elementals. This dungeon offers excellent loot and has a strong prison theme.

title: Dire Maul
content: Dire Maul is a level 55-60 dungeon complex located in Feralas. This ancient night elf ruin is divided into three wings: Warpwood Quarter, Capital Gardens, and Gordok Commons. Key bosses include Pusillin, Lethtendris, and King Gordok. Players fight through corrupted wildlife and ogres. This dungeon offers good loot and has a strong nature corruption theme.

title: Maraudon
content: Maraudon is a level 45-55 dungeon located in the Valley of Spears in Desolace. This ancient centaur burial ground is corrupted by the evil Princess Theradras. Key bosses include Noxxion, Razorlash, and Princess Theradras herself. Players fight through caverns filled with centaurs and earthen elementals. This dungeon offers good loot and has a strong earth and corruption theme.

title: Sunken Temple
content: Sunken Temple is a level 50-60 dungeon located in the Swamp of Sorrows. This ancient troll temple is controlled by the Atal'ai and corrupted by Hakkar the Soulflayer. Key bosses include Jammal'an the Prophet, Shade of Eranikus, and Avatar of Hakkar. Players fight through temple chambers battling trolls and dragons. This dungeon offers excellent loot and has a strong troll and corruption theme.

title: Zul'Farrak
content: Zul'Farrak is a level 44-54 dungeon located in Tanaris. This ancient troll city is controlled by the Sandfury trolls and Chief Ukorz Sandscalp. Key bosses include Antu'sul, Theka the Martyr, and Chief Ukorz. Players fight through sandy ruins battling trolls and hydras. This dungeon offers good loot and has a strong desert and troll theme.

title: Zul'Gurub
content: Zul'Gurub is a level 60 raid dungeon located in Stranglethorn Vale. This ancient troll empire stronghold is controlled by the Gurubashi trolls and Hakkar the Soulflayer. Key bosses include High Priestess Jeklik, Bloodlord Mandokir, and Hakkar himself. Players fight through jungle ruins battling trolls and wildlife. This raid offers excellent loot and has a strong troll and jungle theme.

title: Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj
content: Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj is a level 60 raid dungeon located in Silithus. This ancient qiraji fortress is controlled by the silithid and their leaders. Key bosses include Kurinnaxx, General Rajaxx, and Ossirian the Unscarred. Players fight through sandy ruins battling insectoid enemies. This raid offers excellent loot and is part of the Ahn'Qiraj War Effort.

title: Temple of Ahn'Qiraj
content: Temple of Ahn'Qiraj is a level 60 raid dungeon located in Silithus. This massive qiraji temple is home to C'Thun and his lieutenants. Key bosses include The Prophet Skeram, Princess Huhuran, and C'Thun himself. Players fight through temple chambers battling insectoid horrors. This raid offers the best loot in Classic WoW and features extremely complex encounters.
